metaTitle: Emergency Septic Service in Bemidji, MN | Shepard
metaDesc: Septic backups, frozen lines, and failures handled fast across the Bemidji and Leech Lake area. Call Shepard Excavating now at (218) 224-2754.
lead: Backups, frozen lines, and failures do not wait for a good time, and neither do we. Call and we will get a truck headed your way as fast as we can.
included: Frozen septic and water line thawing and steaming
Figuring out what went wrong and what it takes to fix it
expect: Call (218) 224-2754 and tell us what is happening. We will talk you through anything you can safely check yourself, then get out to you and get it handled. If your system is backing up, stop running water and call.

faqs.q: What counts as a septic emergency?
faqs.a: A backup into the house, an overflow, a frozen line, a screaming alarm, or standing water over the drain field. When in doubt, call and we will help you figure it out.

faqs.q: Can you thaw a frozen line?
faqs.a: Yes. We steam frozen septic and water lines to open them back up, which is common work for us in the winter.

faqs.q: Should I keep using water if it is backing up?
faqs.a: No. Stop running water to keep it from getting worse, and give us a call right away.

faqs.q: How fast can you get here?
faqs.a: As fast as we can get a truck on the road. We serve the whole Bemidji and Leech Lake area, so we are usually not far.
